CAMPAIGN 01 · MINH LONG I

HealthyCook

Taking porcelain cookware beyond the table.

Product launch
CHALLENGE

Minh Long was known for tea sets and tableware; HealthyCook created a new cookware proposition.

STRATEGIC MOVE

Positioned porcelain cookware around “boiling and steaming without water,” translating a product feature into a consumer-facing benefit.

CAMPAIGN EXECUTION

360° launch across events, YouTube video series, Facebook performance ads, PR, OOH and showroom activation.

REPORTED OUTCOME: Top 3 revenue-contributing brand for Minh Long.

CAMPAIGN 02 · VITADAIRY

ColosBaby

Repositioning around 24-hour colostrum immunity.

Brand repositioning
CHALLENGE

The brand had been in market since 2012 and relied heavily on store-owner consultation, with low consumer awareness.

STRATEGIC MOVE

Used focus groups, market research and product features to sharpen the immunity-support proposition around ColosIgG 24h.

CAMPAIGN EXECUTION

360° IMC spanning TVC, events and in-store activation to build trust and engage parents.

REPORTED OUTCOME: Strong Top-of-Mind for infant formula supporting immunity.

Bảo vệ Bác sĩ 24h

Turning public attention into support for frontline doctors.

CSR / Social impact
CHALLENGE
